text: As Barrow, Alaska, enters its month-long polar night, a stranger walks in from a hidden ship and [burns the phones, wrecks the helicopter and kills the sled dogs|trigger|cut off and trapped]. Sheriff Eben Oleson and his estranged wife Stella find the telecommunications man's head on a spike before [a band of vampires|threat|blood drinkers] sweeps through the snow, dragging townspeople from their homes. A handful of survivors hides in an attic, waiting for a storm to cover their move as [the vampires raid the houses around them|who_suffers|whole communities].
